Dtype queries and promotion

Source: R/numpy_misc.R
jnp_dtype_functions.Rd

Ports of jnp.issubdtype, jnp.isdtype, jnp.promote_types, jnp.result_type and jnp.can_cast. Dtypes may be given as names, scalar types such as jnp_float32 or arrays. promote_types uses JAX's promotion lattice and does not canonicalize 64-bit types; result_type promotes values (R scalars are weakly typed) and canonicalizes like JAX. can_cast follows NumPy's casting rules.

Usage

jnp_issubdtype(arg1, arg2)

jnp_isdtype(dtype, kind)

jnp_promote_types(a, b)

jnp_result_type(...)

jnp_can_cast(from_, to, casting = "safe")

Arguments

arg1

A dtype, or an abstract category such as jnp_floating.

arg2

A dtype or an abstract category.

dtype

A dtype.

kind

A dtype or one of "bool", "signed integer", "unsigned integer", "integral", "real floating", "complex floating", "numeric", or a vector (list) of these.

a, b

Dtypes.

...

Arrays, R values, dtypes or NULL (the default float type).

from_, to

Dtypes (or arrays).

casting

One of "no", "equiv", "safe", "same_kind", "unsafe".

Value

A logical scalar, or a dtype string.
